Class AbstractUpdateBuilder<T, S extends AbstractUpdateBuilder<T,S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractUpdateBuilder<T,S>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncUpdateBuilder, UpdateBuilder
public abstract class AbstractUpdateBuilder<T, S extends AbstractUpdateBuilder<T,S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async update-item builders.

Supports both full-item replacement and partial updates via an UpdateExpression. Concrete subclasses provide the DynamoDB table and client references and implement the execute logic.

    • ignoreNulls

      public @NonNull S ignoreNulls(boolean ignoreNulls)
      Controls whether null-valued attributes in the item are ignored during full-item replacement. Has no effect when using a partial update expression.
      Parameters:
      ignoreNulls - true (default) to skip null attributes, false to persist them
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • returnValues

      public @NonNull S returnValues(@Nullable software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.model.ReturnValue returnValues)
      Configures which item attributes to return after the update.

      When set, controls the ReturnValues parameter of the underlying UpdateItemRequest. Common values: ReturnValue.ALL_NEW (default if not set), ReturnValue.NONE, ReturnValue.ALL_OLD, ReturnValue.UPDATED_NEW, ReturnValue.UPDATED_OLD.

      Parameters:
      returnValues - the return value setting, or null to use the default
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • withOptimisticLocking

      public @NonNull S withOptimisticLocking()
      Enables optimistic locking for this update operation.

      When enabled, the library adds a condition expression checking that the version attribute hasn't changed, and increments the version on success.

      This is only supported for full-item replacement. For partial updates (update(Consumer)), the item must be provided in the constructor.

      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • applyOptimisticLocking

      protected void applyOptimisticLocking()
      Applies optimistic locking by merging a version condition into the existing condition expression (if any). Has no effect when the item is null (key-only update) or when optimistic locking is not enabled.

    • incrementVersion

      protected void incrementVersion()
      Increments the version field on the item if optimistic locking is enabled and the item is not null.
